newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Templeton to give Sumitomo Life investment advice.
newsitem.headline: Templeton to give Sumitomo Life investment advice.

text.p: Franklin/Templeton Group has reached an agreement to provide Sumitomo Life investment advice on Asia ex-Japan equity investment, Templeton said on Monday.

Under the contract, which was signed last week, Templeton will provide Sumitomo Life with information on stock markets in the Asian region and individual stock recommendations for Sumitomo's Asian equity investment.

In addition, Sumitomo Life will purchase shares in Luxembourg-based Templeton Global Strategy Funds in order to enhance the performance of Sumitomo's asset management division and to improve the diversification of its equity portfolio, Templeton said.
Sumitomo Life is Japan's third-largest life insurance company, with total assets of 23 trillion yen, or about US$200 billion.
The Franklin-Templeton Group manages funds in excess of US$200 billion.
